answer_text:
Namebeam tracks answers and citations across specific regional and niche market panels rather than as a single global domain tally for all questions combined.
Where it is published: The data is published on Namebeam and its research portal, Namebeam Market Panels, as well as open datasets on Hugging Face.
Per-question/market breakdown: For the date range of September 1 to September 26/27, 2026, Perplexity domain citations vary by the specific geographic market and buyer-intent query tracked (for example, counting individual domain occurrences per panel like consumeraffairs.com, expertise.com, and local business sites across sample reports).
If you specify a particular city or niche (such as Miami roofing or Phoenix HVAC) from the Namebeam Market Panels, I can pull the exact domain citation count for that specific dataset.
